description: Fixed 16-byte stack buffer overflowed by an unchecked mem_copy() of 64 bytes; safe twin clamps the copy length first.

cases.reason: mem_copy(buf, input, 64) writes 64 bytes into a 16-byte stack buffer. The bounds oracle must observe writes to buf+16..buf+63 (48 bytes out of bounds) during emulation from reset.
Copy length is clamped to sizeof(buf)-1 before mem_copy() runs. Every write during emulation lands inside [buf, buf+16). No OOB access is ever observed.
